CHURCH FAMILY MEAL

The table is set.

Every last Sunday, our Church community gathers for a meal together. Good food, real conversation, and the kind of belonging that only happens when you slow down long enough to share a table.

Here’s what you need to know.

Let Us Know You’re Coming

WHY WE DO THIS

Scripture is full of people gathered around tables.

From the feeding of the five thousand, to the Last Supper, to Jesus cooking breakfast on the beach for His disciples after the resurrection — God has always used meals as a place of connection, healing, and real presence.

We believe some of the best conversations, deepest friendships, and most honest moments still happen across the table. So every month, on the last Sunday, we practice the simple and beautiful habit of breaking bread together.

This meal is made possible by the generosity of our whole community. If you can bring something, we would love that. If you can’t, we still want you to come and eat with us — because there will be plenty of food for everyone.

“And day by day, attending the temple together and breaking bread in their homes, they received their food with glad and generous hearts.”

Acts 2:46

LET US KNOW YOU’RE COMING

RSVP and let us know what you can bring.

Fill out the form and let us know who is coming with you and what you can bring to the table. Every dish helps.

Can’t bring anything?

Come anyway. This meal happens because of the generosity of our whole community, and there will be plenty of food for everyone. Your presence at the table is more than enough.

Step 1 Tell us you’re coming.
Step 2 Let us know what you can bring.
Step 3 Show up, eat, laugh, and belong.

WHILE YOU’RE HERE

The meal is even better after we worship together.

Come join us for the Sunday gathering first. Something happens when a room full of people worships together — and then sits down to eat together. It is worth experiencing.
